player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in an infinite loop between the Attic, Laundry room, and Bathroom, repeatedly moving south/east/north/west without ever exploring the "west" direction available in the Bathroom or the "north" direction available in the Attic that might lead elsewhere. I failed to track visited rooms or detect cycles. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms. Upon entering a room, I will check if I have been there before. If I have, I will immediately try a new, untried direction instead of repeating the previous one. Specifically, when in the Bathroom, I will try "west" first before going south, and when in the Attic, I will try "north" before going east, ensuring I exhaust all unique paths from each node before backtracking.
